recruit.brief: A picnic in Harbor Park, 2038. Everything in it existed then. So is it real? Look at the light.
recruit.question: Real or altered? Make your first call before you check anything.

cadet.brief: A picnic in the park. Look at all the shadows.
cadet.question: Real, or changed?

operative.question: Real or altered? The date check alone can't decide this one.
